bmo2-2021-q1.summary: Call a positive integer $n$ good if some set of distinct positive divisors of $n$ includes $1$ and has sum $n$. Prove that every positive integer has a multiple which is good.
bmo2-2021-q1.summaryZh: 若正整数 $n$ 的某个互不相同的正因数集合包含 $1$，且这些因数之和等于 $n$，则称 $n$ 为好数。证明每个正整数都有一个倍数是好数。
bmo2-2021-q1.answer: For every positive integer $m$, the number $N!$ with $N=\max(m,3)$ is a good multiple of $m$.
bmo2-2021-q1.answerZh: 对任意正整数 $m$，令 $N=\max(m,3)$，则 $N!$ 是 $m$ 的一个好数倍数。

methods.title: Prove inductively that every factorial from $3!$ onward is good
methods.titleZh: 归纳证明从 $3!$ 起的每个阶乘都是好数
steps: The base case is $3!=6=1+2+3$, using distinct divisors and including $1$.
Suppose $r!$ is good for some $r\ge3$, so $r!=1+d_1+\cdots+d_s$, where the $d_i$ are distinct divisors of $r!$ different from $1$. Then $(r+1)! = 1+r+(r+1)d_1+\cdots+(r+1)d_s$.

Indeed, the displayed right side equals $1+r+(r+1)(r!-1)=(r+1)r!$. Every displayed term divides $(r+1)!$: the scaled terms do because $d_i\mid r!$, while $1$ and $r$ plainly do. They are distinct, since the scaled terms are at least $r+1$ and retain the distinctness of the $d_i$. Thus $(r+1)!$ is good.
By induction, $N!$ is good for every $N\ge3$. Given $m$, choose $N=\max(m,3)$. Then $m\mid N!$, so this good number is a multiple of the original integer.
stepsZh: 基础情形为 $3!=6=1+2+3$，所用因数互不相同且包含 $1$。
设对某个 $r\ge3$，$r!$ 是好数，即 $r!=1+d_1+\cdots+d_s$，其中 $d_i$ 是互不相同且不等于 $1$ 的 $r!$ 的因数。则有 $(r+1)! = 1+r+(r+1)d_1+\cdots+(r+1)d_s$。
右边确实等于 $1+r+(r+1)(r!-1)=(r+1)r!$。其中每一项都整除 $(r+1)!$：$(r+1)d_i$ 整除它，而 $1,r$ 也显然整除它。这些因数彼此不同，因为所有放大后的因数至少为 $r+1$，且仍保持 $d_i$ 之间的互异性。因此 $(r+1)!$ 也是好数。
由归纳法，对每个 $N\ge3$，$N!$ 都是好数。给定 $m$，取 $N=\max(m,3)$，则 $m\mid N!$，所以这个好数就是原整数的一个倍数。

methods.title: A direct binary construction for the odd part
methods.titleZh: 对奇数部分作二进制直接构造
steps: Write the given integer as $m=2^s a$ with $a$ odd. If $a>1$, choose $k\ge s$ so large that every power of $2$ occurring in the binary expansion of $a$ is at most $2^{k-1}$, and put $n=2^k a$.

The distinct divisors $a,2a,\ldots,2^{k-1}a$ sum to $(2^k-1)a=n-a$. The binary expansion writes the odd number $a$ as a sum of distinct powers of $2$, including $1$; all these powers divide $n$. None equals a divisor in the first list because $a>1$. Together the two lists sum to $n$, so $n$ is good, and $m\mid n$.

If $a=1$, start from the good number $6=1+2+3$. Whenever $u>1$ is good, adjoining the divisor $u$ to a good divisor set for $u$ proves that $2u$ is good. Repeated doubling gives a good multiple of $2^s=m$.
stepsZh: 把给定整数写成 $m=2^s a$，其中 $a$ 为奇数。若 $a>1$，取充分大的 $k\ge s$，使 $a$ 的二进制展开中出现的每个二次幂都不超过 $2^{k-1}$，并令 $n=2^k a$。
互异因数 $a,2a,\ldots,2^{k-1}a$ 的和为 $(2^k-1)a=n-a$。另一方面，奇数 $a$ 的二进制展开把它写成若干互异二次幂之和，其中包括 $1$；这些二次幂也都整除 $n$。由于 $a>1$，它们不会与第一组因数重合。两组因数合起来恰好和为 $n$，故 $n$ 是好数，且 $m\mid n$。
若 $a=1$，从好数 $6=1+2+3$ 出发。若 $u>1$ 为好数，在表示 $u$ 的因数集合中再加入因数 $u$，即可证明 $2u$ 是好数。反复加倍便得到 $2^s=m$ 的一个好数倍数。

bmo2-2021-q2.summary: Eliza has arbitrarily many square tiles of side lengths $a$ and $b$, where $a,b$ are positive integers. She uses some of both available types, without overlap, to tile an $n\times n$ square. Prove that another $n\times n$ square can be tiled using just one of the two tile sizes.
bmo2-2021-q2.summaryZh: Eliza 有足够多的两种正方形瓷砖，边长分别为正整数 $a,b$。她用这些瓷砖中的若干块，无重叠地铺满一个 $n\times n$ 正方形。证明：另一个同样大小的正方形可以只用其中一种尺寸的瓷砖铺满。
bmo2-2021-q2.answer: The existence of the mixed tiling forces $a\mid n$ or $b\mid n$; use the corresponding tile alone.
bmo2-2021-q2.answerZh: 混合铺法必然推出 $a\mid n$ 或 $b\mid n$；只用相应尺寸的瓷砖即可铺满。

methods.title: Assign periodic weights to the rows
steps: If $a\mid n$, an $n\times n$ square is immediately tiled by an $(n/a)\times(n/a)$ array of $a\times a$ tiles. It remains to prove that if $a\nmid n$, then $b\mid n$.
Number the unit-cell rows $1,\ldots,n$. Give every cell in a row numbered $1\pmod a$ weight $+1$, every cell in a row numbered $0\pmod a$ weight $-1$, and every other cell weight $0$.
Because $a\nmid n$, the row weights from $1$ through $n$ cancel in complete blocks of $a$ and leave one extra $+1$. With $n$ cells per row, the total weight of the board is therefore $n$.

Every $a\times a$ tile spans $a$ consecutive rows, whose row weights sum to $0$, so its total weight is $0$. Every $b\times b$ tile has $b$ cells in each row it meets, so its total weight is a multiple of $b$. Since the tiles partition the board, the board's total weight $n$ must be divisible by $b$.
Thus either $a\mid n$ or $b\mid n$. In the first case use only $a\times a$ tiles; in the second use only $b\times b$ tiles.
stepsZh: 若 $a\mid n$，把大正方形分成 $(n/a)\times(n/a)$ 个 $a\times a$ 小正方形即可。下面只需证明：若 $a\nmid n$，则必有 $b\mid n$。
把单位方格的行编号为 $1,\ldots,n$。行号模 $a$ 余 $1$ 的每个格赋权 $+1$，行号能被 $a$ 整除的每个格赋权 $-1$，其他格赋权 $0$。
因 $a\nmid n$，从第 $1$ 行到第 $n$ 行的权值在每个完整的 $a$ 行块中互相抵消，最后多出一个 $+1$。每行有 $n$ 格，所以整块棋盘的总权值为 $n$。
每块 $a\times a$ 瓷砖跨越连续 $a$ 行，这些行权值之和为 $0$，所以它的总权值为 $0$。每块 $b\times b$ 瓷砖在所跨每一行中都有 $b$ 格，因此其总权值是 $b$ 的倍数。所有瓷砖恰好分割棋盘，所以棋盘总权值 $n$ 必须被 $b$ 整除。
因此必有 $a\mid n$ 或 $b\mid n$。前一种情形只用 $a\times a$ 瓷砖，后一种情形只用 $b\times b$ 瓷砖。

methods.title: Track the top edges of the $b\times b$ tiles
methods.titleZh: 追踪 $b\times b$ 瓷砖的顶边
steps: Call a cell special when it lies in the top row of a $b\times b$ tile. In any board row, the number of cells covered by $b\times b$ tiles is congruent to $n$ modulo $a$, because the remaining cells are covered in blocks of width $a$.

A special cell contributes a cell of its $b\times b$ tile to that row and to the next $b-1$ rows. Inducting downward shows that the number of special cells in rows $1,b+1,2b+1,\ldots$ is congruent to $n\pmod a$, while in other rows it is $0\pmod a$.

All $b$-tiles meeting the bottom row start in row $n-b+1$. The special-cell count there is congruent to $n\pmod a$. Hence either $n\equiv0\pmod a$, or $n-b+1\equiv1\pmod b$, which gives $b\mid n$. This again proves the required dichotomy.
stepsZh: 若某格位于一块 $b\times b$ 瓷砖的最上行，就称它为特殊格。在大正方形任意一行中，被 $b\times b$ 瓷砖覆盖的格数模 $a$ 同余于 $n$，因为其余格都以宽度为 $a$ 的块出现。
每个特殊格所属的瓷砖在该行及其下方 $b-1$ 行各贡献一个格。自上而下归纳可得：第 $1,b+1,2b+1,\ldots$ 行的特殊格数模 $a$ 同余于 $n$，其他行的特殊格数模 $a$ 同余于 $0$。
所有接触底行的 $b$ 瓷砖，其顶行都是第 $n-b+1$ 行；该行特殊格数模 $a$ 同余于 $n$。因此要么 $n\equiv0\pmod a$，要么 $n-b+1\equiv1\pmod b$，后者给出 $b\mid n$。这再次证明了所需二分结论。

bmo2-2021-q3.summary: Let $ABC$ be a triangle with $AB>AC$, circumcircle $\Gamma$, incentre $I$, and incircle touchpoint $D$ on $BC$. Let $K$ be the second intersection of $\Gamma$ with the circle having diameter $AI$; equivalently, $K\in\Gamma$ and $\angle AKI=90^\circ$. Prove that the lines $AI$ and $KD$ meet at a point of $\Gamma$.
bmo2-2021-q3.summaryZh: 设三角形 $ABC$ 满足 $AB>AC$，外接圆为 $\Gamma$，内心为 $I$，内切圆与 $BC$ 的切点为 $D$。令 $K$ 为 $\Gamma$ 与以 $AI$ 为直径的圆除 $A$ 外的交点；等价地，$K\in\Gamma$ 且 $\angle AKI=90^\circ$。证明直线 $AI$ 与 $KD$ 的交点位于 $\Gamma$ 上。
bmo2-2021-q3.answer: If $M$ is the midpoint of the arc $BC$ not containing $A$, then $M\in AI\cap KD\cap\Gamma$.
bmo2-2021-q3.answerZh: 若 $M$ 是不含 $A$ 的弧 $BC$ 的中点，则 $M\in AI\cap KD\cap\Gamma$。

methods.title: Use the two circles to obtain the angle-bisector ratio
methods.titleZh: 利用两个圆得到角平分线比例

topics.zh: 角平分线定理的逆定理

steps: Let the incircle touch $CA$ and $AB$ at $E$ and $F$. Since $IE\perp AC$, $IF\perp AB$, and $\angle AKI=90^\circ$, the five points $A,E,I,F,K$ lie on the circle with diameter $AI$.

The triangles $KFB$ and $KEC$ are similar using directed angles. Indeed, $\angle KBF=\angle KBA=\angle KCA=\angle KCE$ because $A,B,C,K$ are cyclic, and $\angle KFB=\angle KFA=\angle KEA=\angle KEC$ modulo $180^\circ$ because $A,E,F,K$ are cyclic and $A,E,C$ are collinear.

Therefore $KB/KC=BF/CE$. Equal tangents to the incircle give $BF=BD$ and $CE=CD$, so $KB/KC=BD/DC$. By the converse of the internal angle-bisector theorem in triangle $KBC$, the line $KD$ bisects $\angle BKC$.

The line $AI$ meets $\Gamma$ again at the midpoint $M$ of the arc $BC$ not containing $A$. Since the arcs $BM$ and $MC$ are equal, $KM$ also bisects $\angle BKC$. The internal angle bisector is unique, so $K,D,M$ are collinear. Thus $AI$ and $KD$ meet at $M\in\Gamma$.
stepsZh: 设内切圆与 $CA,AB$ 的切点分别为 $E,F$。因 $IE\perp AC$、$IF\perp AB$ 且 $\angle AKI=90^\circ$，五点 $A,E,I,F,K$ 都位于以 $AI$ 为直径的圆上。
用有向角可证三角形 $KFB$ 与 $KEC$ 相似。由 $A,B,C,K$ 共圆，$\angle KBF=\angle KBA=\angle KCA=\angle KCE$；又由 $A,E,F,K$ 共圆及 $A,E,C$ 共线，模 $180^\circ$ 有 $\angle KFB=\angle KFA=\angle KEA=\angle KEC$。
因此 $KB/KC=BF/CE$。同一点向内切圆所作切线段相等，故 $BF=BD$、$CE=CD$，从而 $KB/KC=BD/DC$。在三角形 $KBC$ 中应用内角平分线定理的逆定理，得到 $KD$ 平分 $\angle BKC$。
直线 $AI$ 与 $\Gamma$ 的另一交点 $M$ 是不含 $A$ 的弧 $BC$ 的中点。因弧 $BM$ 与 $MC$ 相等，$KM$ 也平分 $\angle BKC$。内角平分线唯一，所以 $K,D,M$ 共线。因此 $AI$ 与 $KD$ 交于圆上点 $M$。

methods.title: Construct the desired intersection first
methods.titleZh: 先构造所需的圆上交点
steps: Let $M=AI\cap\Gamma$ with $M\ne A$, so $M$ is the midpoint of the arc $BC$ not containing $A$. Extend $MD$ to meet $\Gamma$ again at $K'$. It is enough to prove $\angle AK'I=90^\circ$, because the second intersection of $\Gamma$ with the circle having diameter $AI$ is unique.

Write $A,B,C$ also for the angles of triangle $ABC$. Since $M$ is the arc midpoint, $\angle MK'B=\angle CBM=A/2$. As $K',D,M$ are collinear, this is exactly the tangent--chord angle needed to show that $MB$ is tangent at $B$ to the circle through $B,D,K'$. Hence $MB^2=MD\cdot MK'$.

The standard incenter--arc-midpoint fact gives $MB=MC=MI$. Thus $MI^2=MD\cdot MK'$, and the converse tangent--secant theorem shows that $MI$ is tangent at $I$ to the circle through $D,I,K'$. Since $ID\perp BC$, $BI$ bisects angle $B$, and $A,I,M$ are collinear, the resulting tangent--chord relation gives $\angle MID=(B-C)/2$ as a directed angle.

Following the rays around $K'$ and using $A,B,C,K'$ cyclic, $\angle MK'B=A/2$, and the preceding tangent--chord equality, we obtain $\angle AK'I=(180^\circ-C)-(B-C)/2-A/2=180^\circ-(A+B+C)/2=90^\circ$.
Thus $K'=K$. Since $K'$ was constructed on $MD$ and $M$ lies on $AI$, the required lines meet at $M\in\Gamma$.
stepsZh: 令 $M=AI\cap\Gamma$ 且 $M\ne A$，则 $M$ 是不含 $A$ 的弧 $BC$ 的中点。延长 $MD$ 再次交 $\Gamma$ 于 $K'$。只需证明 $\angle AK'I=90^\circ$，因为 $\Gamma$ 与以 $AI$ 为直径的圆除 $A$ 外只有一个交点。
仍用 $A,B,C$ 表示三角形的三个角。因 $M$ 是弧中点，$\angle MK'B=\angle CBM=A/2$。又因 $K',D,M$ 共线，这正是证明 $MB$ 为圆 $BDK'$ 在 $B$ 点切线所需的切线弦角关系。因此 $MB^2=MD\cdot MK'$。
内心与弧中点的标准性质给出 $MB=MC=MI$。故 $MI^2=MD\cdot MK'$；由切割线定理的逆定理，$MI$ 是圆 $DIK'$ 在 $I$ 点的切线。结合 $ID\perp BC$、$BI$ 平分角 $B$ 以及 $A,I,M$ 共线，切线弦角关系给出有向角 $\angle MID=(B-C)/2$。
沿 $K'$ 点各射线的顺序追角，并使用 $A,B,C,K'$ 共圆、$\angle MK'B=A/2$ 及上一步的切线弦角关系，得到 $\angle AK'I=(180^\circ-C)-(B-C)/2-A/2=180^\circ-(A+B+C)/2=90^\circ$。
因此 $K'=K$。由于 $K'$ 按构造位于 $MD$ 上，而 $M$ 位于 $AI$ 上，故所求两直线交于 $M\in\Gamma$。

bmo2-2021-q4.summary: Matthew constructs a sequence $a_1,a_2,\ldots$ of positive integers. At stage $n$, he chooses $a_n$ to be the smallest positive integer not used earlier for which the mean of $a_1,\ldots,a_n$ is an integer. Prove that the sequence $b_i=a_i-i$ contains every integer exactly once.
bmo2-2021-q4.summaryZh: Matthew 构造正整数序列 $a_1,a_2,\ldots$。在第 $n$ 步，他选择尚未出现过的最小正整数 $a_n$，使 $a_1,\ldots,a_n$ 的平均数为整数。证明序列 $b_i=a_i-i$ 中每个整数恰好出现一次。
bmo2-2021-q4.answer: For every integer $z$, there is a unique positive integer $i$ with $a_i-i=z$.
bmo2-2021-q4.answerZh: 对每个整数 $z$，恰有一个正整数 $i$ 满足 $a_i-i=z$。

methods.title: Show that the attained differences are always a growing interval
methods.titleZh: 证明已出现的差值始终组成不断扩张的整数区间
steps: Put $b_i=a_i-i$. We prove by induction that $b_1,\ldots,b_n$ are $n$ consecutive integers in some order. The base case is $a_1=1$, so $b_1=0$.
Assume the claim through $n$, and let $B_n=\max(b_1,\ldots,b_n)$. The $n$ values are then the interval $B_n-n+1,\ldots,B_n$, which contains $0$; in particular $B_n<n$.

The number $x=n+2+B_n$ is an admissible unused choice for $a_{n+1}$. Indeed, the $n+1$ prospective terms split as $(1,2,\ldots,n,n+1)$ plus the consecutive integers $(b_1,\ldots,b_n,B_n+1)$. Each list has an integer mean or each has a half-integer mean, so their sum has integer mean. Also $x>a_i$ for every earlier $i$.

Every admissible next value is congruent to $x$ modulo $n+1$. Since $a_{n+1}\le x$ and $x-2(n+1)=B_n-n\le0$, the only positive possibilities are $x$ and $x-(n+1)=B_n+1$. Hence $b_{n+1}$ is respectively $B_n+1$ or $B_n-n$: exactly the new integer just above or just below the current interval. The induction follows, and no integer can occur twice.

It remains to show that the interval expands without bound in both directions. If its upper endpoint eventually stopped increasing, every later step would add the new lower endpoint. Then $b_n$ would decrease by $1$ at each step and $a_n=n+b_n$ would eventually be constant, contradicting the requirement that the $a_n$ are distinct. Thus the upper endpoints are unbounded.

Suppose instead that the lower endpoint eventually stopped decreasing. Then for all large $n$ every step adds the upper endpoint, so $b_n=n-\delta$ and $a_n=2n-\delta$ for a fixed integer $\delta$. At stage $n$, replacing the admissible $a_n$ by $a_n-n=n-\delta$ preserves divisibility of the total by $n$. Since the algorithm did not choose this smaller positive number, it must already occur among $a_1,\ldots,a_{n-1}$.

For infinitely many large odd $n$, the number $n-\delta$ cannot equal a later-tail value $2j-\delta$, because that would require the odd number $n$ to equal $2j$. It would therefore have to lie in one fixed finite initial segment, impossible for infinitely many distinct values of $n-\delta$. Hence the lower endpoints are also unbounded. The nested consecutive intervals therefore exhaust all integers, each exactly once.
stepsZh: 令 $b_i=a_i-i$。用归纳法证明：$b_1,\ldots,b_n$ 按某种顺序恰为 $n$ 个连续整数。基础情形中 $a_1=1$，所以 $b_1=0$。
设结论对前 $n$ 项成立，并记 $B_n=\max(b_1,\ldots,b_n)$。这 $n$ 个数就是区间 $B_n-n+1,\ldots,B_n$，且其中包含 $0$，所以 $B_n<n$。
数 $x=n+2+B_n$ 是 $a_{n+1}$ 的一个合法且未用过的候选。事实上，未来的 $n+1$ 项可拆成 $(1,2,\ldots,n,n+1)$ 与连续整数 $(b_1,\ldots,b_n,B_n+1)$ 之和。两列的平均数要么同为整数，要么同为半整数，因此总平均数为整数。又有 $x>a_i$ 对所有旧项成立。
所有合法的下一项都与 $x$ 模 $n+1$ 同余。因为 $a_{n+1}\le x$ 且 $x-2(n+1)=B_n-n\le0$，不超过 $x$ 的正候选只有 $x$ 与 $x-(n+1)=B_n+1$。因此 $b_{n+1}$ 分别为 $B_n+1$ 或 $B_n-n$，恰好是在原区间的上端或下端添一个新整数。归纳完成，也说明任何整数至多出现一次。
还需证明区间向两端都无界扩张。若上端从某步起不再增加，则以后每步都只能添加新的下端点。于是 $b_n$ 每步减 $1$，从而 $a_n=n+b_n$ 最终保持常数，这与 $a_n$ 必须互不相同矛盾。因此上端无界。
反设下端从某步起不再下降，则以后每步都添加上端点，故对所有充分大的 $n$，有 $b_n=n-\delta$、$a_n=2n-\delta$，其中 $\delta$ 为固定整数。在第 $n$ 步，把合法候选 $a_n$ 换成 $a_n-n=n-\delta$，总和模 $n$ 不变，所以它也是合法的更小正数。算法没有选择它，说明它必已在 $a_1,\ldots,a_{n-1}$ 中出现。
对无穷多个充分大的奇数 $n$，$n-\delta$ 不可能等于尾部某项 $2j-\delta$，否则奇数 $n$ 会等于 $2j$。所以它只能来自某个固定的有限初始段；但互不相同的 $n-\delta$ 有无穷多个，矛盾。因此下端也无界。嵌套的连续整数区间最终覆盖全体整数，且每个整数恰出现一次。
